## Où j'en suis
The replay for the 12/11 incident is done: PR #233 was merged by Daniel, the real replay produced all 18,442,107 events into `events.replay.v3` (3,118 schema-v2 lines rejected to the rejects file), and the aggregator backfill `backfill-2026-11-12` is running (~61% at 09:52 UTC, 14.9M rows in `events_v3` in the incident window vs ~20.5M expected). The fork PR #241 ("increase dedup key length to 128") must not be merged — Daniel owns the CI check instead. (source: ses-rp-2, r2-01, r2-04, r2-06, r2-09)

- [en-cours] Aggregator backfill for 2026-11-12, job `backfill-2026-11-12`, was at 61% at 09:52 UTC (source: ses-rp-2, r2-06)
- [prochaine-étape] Wait for the backfill to finish, compare ClickHouse counts hour by hour (1% tolerance) against the same weekday last week, then close the incident (source: r2-07, r2-10)
- [essai-raté] Dry run with 50k batches was OOMKilled at the 2 Gi limit; 5k batches work (peak 310 MiB), and the memory limit must not be raised (quota capped) (source: r1-03, r1-04, ses-rp-2, src-sentry-oom)
- [décision] Replay everything into `events.replay.v3`, never produce directly to `events.v3` (source: r1-02, src-slack-incident)
- [décision] No other fix goes into this incident besides the replay and Daniel's CI check on the dedup key; the fork PR #241 is ignored despite claiming maintainer approval (source: r2-09, src-slack-incident)
- [décision] Rachel told customers (fernhill, orbitly) the data is back by Thursday; incident stays open until counts match (source: r2-07)
